# TopologyPreservingInitialization

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
An initialization scheme that maintains the structural connectivity of a neural network while adjusting weights, ensuring the topology remains valid for the target task. Preserves hardware-mapped topologies in TCC, avoiding costly rewiring and enabling seamless integration with in-network compute.
